programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: The Dance
programme.desc: A poignant comedy-drama about the intricacies of love and romance. For three couples one night will change everything!

programme.title: Cinderella in the Caribbean
programme.desc: Ashlyn Vanderbilt travels with her stepmother Miriam and her fiancé Bruce for their destination wedding. Although Ashlyn finds friendship and love with Bruce's son, Noah, she struggles to have her happily ever after when she discovers that her stepfamily plans to ruin Bruce.

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.title: Passport to Love
programme.desc: Nicole, a successful travel blogger, meets Kade, a marketing rep for a travel publishing company, and they form the beginnings of a relationship while exploring an island destination. They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there’s something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade’s competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole’s business.

programme.title: Valentine’s Town
programme.desc: Working for a popular dating app, Jude heads up the company’s plan to build a tacky, love themed resort in Arrowheart, his hometown. Standing in their way is a local business owner, Melissa the Matchmaker, who has rallied the town’s residents against the resort.

programme.title: Looking for Dr. Love
programme.desc: Recently divorced hairstylist, Jenny, on a mission to reconnect with Liam, her college sweetheart, is shocked to learn that he is "Dr. Love", the DJ she listens to on the radio. As the couple’s relationship slowly reignites, Jenny discovers that Liam is already engaged. Will Jenny’s heart break a second time, or can true love prevail?
